text: The chapter recommends the 3-2-1 backup rule for research data: three copies of the data, on two different media types, with one copy stored offsite.
explanation: The 3-2-1 rule is stated directly in the Data Management section: keep three copies of data, across two different media types, with at least one copy offsite, protecting against both media failure and localized disasters such as a single lab flood or hardware failure.
